Telemetry calibration and bit sense. Source: APRS101 pp.68-70 (profile stateful). Definition messages can arrive before or after values. Keep raw samples to permit recalculation. Do not invent coefficients for undefined channels. Part of sequence SEQ-004; application state after this packet (not checked): {"A1": "Battery", "A2": "Temp", "B1": "Camra", "B2": "Chut"}. Decision: PARM and UNIT lists decode to 13 slots (5 analog channels then 8 bits), keeping empty slots in place; trailing empty slots are not sent, so a definition re-encodes to its shortest form.
